title: Pricing experiment instrumentation in frontend/src/app/ and backend/routers/

implementation_summary.goal: A/B pricing experiment instrumentation across frontend and backend routers with transparent tiers, explicit user consent, zero dark patterns, non-binding interactive calculator, and real institutional contract acceptance.

pricing_tiers.name_vi: Gói Cụm Trường & Sở Giáo Dục

interactive_calculator.non_binding_guarantee: is_binding=False and revenue_recognized_vnd=0.0 on all calculator quotes

consent_and_telemetry.opt_in_rule: Recording telemetry requires has_experiment_consent=True; opt-out requests are strictly honored without penalty (HTTP 400 with CONSENT_REQUIRED)
consent_and_telemetry.zero_dark_pattern: No forced renewals, no auto-charges, full transparency notices displayed on all tiers

contract_acceptance.draft_creation: Authenticated school reps create pending_signature contracts (/api/v1/pricing/contracts)
contract_acceptance.execution: Dual-attribution signing with legal signatory verification and SHA-256 cryptographic proof (/api/v1/pricing/contracts/{id}/accept)
contract_acceptance.double_sign_protection: Executed contracts cannot be re-signed (fails closed with HTTP 400)

negative_abuse_guardrail.rule: Merely clicking on a pricing tier or calculator does NOT count as a paying customer or revenue.
enforcement: PricingExperimentEvent tier_view, calculator_interaction, and quote_inquiry events strictly enforce is_paying_customer=False and revenue_impact_vnd=0.0
Direct telemetry submission of contract_accepted via /events is strictly rejected (HTTP 400 DIRECT_CONTRACT_ACCEPTED_PROHIBITED)
Summary metrics (/api/v1/pricing/metrics/summary) only accumulate paying customers and recognized revenue from signed_and_executed contracts with cryptographic signatures
